1: // Manifest basenames yul knows how to check, mirroring pkg/*'s Filename()
2: // values (githubactions workflows use MatchesPath instead of a fixed name,
3: // so they're matched separately below).
4: const MANIFEST_RE = /(^|[/\\ '"=])(pom\.xml|requirements\.txt|pyproject\.toml|package\.json|go\.mod|Cargo\.toml|\.github\/workflows\/[^\s'"]+\.ya?ml)(?=[/\\ '"]|$)/
5: // Shell constructs that mutate a file's *content* on disk - not an
6: // exhaustive parse of bash, just enough to catch the bypass a live model
7: // actually used (`printf ... > requirements.txt`) plus its common cousins.
8: const WRITE_RE = />>?(?!&)|\btee\b|\bsed\s+-i|\bperl\s+-i|\bdd\s+of=|\bcp\s|\bmv\s/
9: 
10: export const YulPlugin = async () => {
11:   const YUL_BIN = process.env.YUL_BIN || "yul"
12:   return {
13:     "tool.execute.before": async (input, output) => {
14:       if (input.tool === "bash") {
15:         const cmd = output.args.command || ""
16:         if (MANIFEST_RE.test(cmd) && WRITE_RE.test(cmd)) {
17:           throw new Error(
18:             "yul: use the write or edit tool to modify dependency manifests, not bash " +
19:             "(bash writes bypass the outdated-dependency check)"
20:           )
21:         }
22:         return
23:       }
24:       if (input.tool !== "write" && input.tool !== "edit") return
25:       const a = output.args
26:       const payload = input.tool === "write"
27:         ? { tool_name: "Write", tool_input: { file_path: a.filePath, content: a.content } }
28:         : {
29:             tool_name: "Edit",
30:             tool_input: {
31:               file_path: a.filePath,
32:               old_string: a.oldString,
33:               new_string: a.newString,
34:               replace_all: !!a.replaceAll,
35:             },
36:           }
37: 
38:       const proc = Bun.spawn([YUL_BIN], { stdin: "pipe", stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" })
39:       proc.stdin.write(JSON.stringify(payload))
40:       proc.stdin.end()
41:       const [code, stderr] = await Promise.all([proc.exited, new Response(proc.stderr).text()])
42:       if (code === 2) throw new Error(stderr.trim() || "yul: blocked outdated dependency")
43:     },
44:   }
45: }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"

    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>4.1.1</version>
        <relativePath/>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>demo</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>demo</name>
    <description>Spring Boot JPA/Hibernate persistence demo</description>

    <properties>

            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>

            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-data-jpa-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

</project>

Done. Scaffolded a Spring Boot 4.1.1 Maven project with JPA/Hibernate and verified it builds and tests pass (6/6).

Structure:
- `pom.xml` — parent `spring-boot-starter-parent:4.1.1`, Java 21, starters: `data-jpa`, `webmvc`, `validation`; H2 + PostgreSQL drivers; test deps.
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/` — `DemoApplication`, plus `book/` feature with `Book` entity, `BookRepository` (`JpaRepository`), `BookService`, `BookController`, exception classes/handler.
- `src/main/resources/` — `application.properties` (H2 in-memory default) and `application-postgres.properties`.
- `src/test/java/.../book/` — `BookRepositoryTest` (`@DataJpaTest`) and `BookServiceTest`.
- `mvnw`/`.mvn/wrapper`, `.gitignore`.

Run: `./mvnw spring-boot:run` (H2 console at `/h2-console`), or `--spring.profiles.active=postgres` for PostgreSQL.

Note: Spring Boot 4 modularized things, so I used `spring-boot-starter-webmvc` (the non-deprecated web starter) and the new `org.springframework.boot.data.jpa.test.autoconfigure.DataJpaTest` with its `spring-boot-data-jpa-test` test dependency.
